liebermann.notes: 12th-century pontifical of the province of Canterbury, probably East Anglian, perhaps from Ely, with Iudicium Dei XI (p. 49) and XII (p. 110) and a Consecratio regis (p. 104); most closely related to Ll.

entries.text_de:
Cambridge Trinity College B 11, 103, Pontifical 12. Jhs. der Provinz Canterbury, wohl Ostenglisch, vielleicht aus Ely.

P. 49 Iud Dei XI, u. S. 419; p. 104 Consecratio regis; p. 110 Iud Dei XII, u. S. 420. Nächst verwandt mit Ll.
entries.text_en:
Cambridge Trinity College B 11, 103, pontifical of the 12th century of the province of Canterbury, probably East Anglian, perhaps from Ely.

P. 49 Iud Dei XI, below, p. 419; p. 104 Consecratio regis; p. 110 Iud Dei XII, below, p. 420. Most closely related to Ll.

notes.text_de: vgl. James Western mss. of Trinity n. 249; Henderson Liber pont. Ebor. p. xxvii. xxxi. 283.
notes.text_en: cf. James Western mss. of Trinity n. 249; Henderson Liber pont. Ebor. pp. xxvii. xxxi. 283.
